Keybinding.networkLowerHint: Lowers the hovered or stepped-to line or symbol of the creature in focus; at its lowest, removes it.
Keybinding.networkRaiseHint: Raises the hovered or stepped-to line or symbol of the creature in focus; on the creature itself, adds a line from it.
Keybinding.networkNextHint: Steps to the focused creature's next line or symbol (with no one in focus, the next creature), while the pointer is over the Battle Vantage.
Keybinding.networkPreviousHint: Steps back to the focused creature's previous line or symbol (with no one in focus, the previous creature), while the pointer is over the Battle Vantage.
Keybinding.closeMenuHint: Closes the menu open in a FastFighting window, and only that: the window stays open.

Generic.Label: Generic d20 (configured paths)
Generic.MenuHint: Where actors keep HP, AC, attack bonus and damage, for the generic adapter.
Generic.Hint: Property paths on the actor, e.g. system.attributes.hp.value. Leave attack or damage empty to estimate them from level.

Path.perception: Perception modifier (optional; the initiative stands in without it)

predictionTime.Name: Prediction time (seconds)
predictionTime.Hint: How long the planner simulates fights. More time, more fights and surer odds.

maxRounds.Name: Max rounds
maxRounds.Hint: A fight that is still going after this many rounds in the simulation is assumed to be a stalemate.

includeHidden.Name: Include hidden tokens
includeHidden.Hint: Hidden tokens outside the encounter, such as ambushers and reinforcements, can take part.

includeOtherLevels.Name: Include other scene levels
includeOtherLevels.Hint: Tokens outside the encounter on the scene's other levels can take part.

neutralDefault.Name: Neutral tokens
neutralDefault.Hint: How tokens with Neutral disposition take part, unless set per token.

downedModel.Name: Downed characters
downedModel.Hint: What 0 HP means. Simulate dying and healing follows the system's rules for dying, recovery and revival.

pcHealAggro.Name: PC healing
pcHealAggro.Hint: How freely PCs spend spells, potions and actions on healing, unless set per character.

pcAllyDying.Name: PCs when an ally is dying
pcAllyDying.Hint: What PCs put first when an ally is dying, unless set per character.

leadership.Name: Leadership
leadership.Hint: Leaders and bosses raise their side's bravery and coordination while they stand.

morale.Name: Morale and routing
morale.Hint: Creatures may waver or flee from fear, wounds, losses or a fallen leader or master.

positioning.Name: Positioning and terrain
positioning.Hint: Uses distances, movement, terrain costs, walls and elevation. Turn off for theater of the mind.

surpriseDefault.Name: Surprise
surpriseDefault.Hint: Who is surprised as a fight starts. Follow System is unavailable where the system has no surprise rules.

lootMode.Name: Slain creatures' gear
lootMode.Hint: What a live battle does with a slain creature's gear.

pcMeat.Name: Dead player characters leave meat
pcMeat.Hint: A dead PC's loot token also holds the meat its body would leave. Its sheet is never touched.

corpseMode.Name: Slain tokens
corpseMode.Hint: Keep slain tokens, marked dead, or remove them. Removing applies only where a loot pile is dropped.

fledMode.Name: Tokens that fled
fledMode.Hint: Hide a token that fled the battle and take it off the tracker, or leave it in place.

sideDefaults.Name: Side personality defaults
sideDefaults.Label: Configure
sideDefaults.Hint: Each side's default group personality: Tactical, Brave, Selfish and Loyal.

talking.Name: Talking
talking.Hint: Characters may talk foes who share a language out of the fight, and win over those who take no side.

ignoreLanguages.Name: Ignore languages
ignoreLanguages.Hint: Anyone who speaks a language understands everyone who does. Creatures with no language still can't be talked to.

storyStyle.Name: Story style
storyStyle.Hint: How the planner's Sample fight and live battles' chat cards tell a fight. Statistician lists every roll, for GMs only.

storyMode.Name: Story delivery
storyMode.Hint: Who sees the story in chat.

bystanders.Name: Bystanders can join
bystanders.Hint: Tokens outside the encounter may notice the fight, be called for help, be hunted or be run into, then decide whether to join.

genericFallback.Name: Use the experimental generic adapter
genericFallback.Hint: Guesses HP, AC, attacks and damage from the data paths below. Expect rough results.

aftermath.Name: After the fight
aftermath.Hint: Whether survivors tend the dying once the fighting stops, and whether the story tells it.

opening.Name: How encounters open
opening.Hint: Whether a fight opens with talk. Talk if they'd rather: a standoff when the leaders would rather talk.

concedeLuck.Name: PC luck: handing over an item
concedeLuck.Hint: A PC talked into giving up an item loses it only on a hidden d100 at or under this.

theftLuck.Name: Thief robs a PC
theftLuck.Hint: Chance a thief who gets past a PC's guard, or robs a fallen PC, takes anything.

playOnMap.Name: Play the fight on the map
playOnMap.Hint: Tokens walk their turns. Off: they jump to where each turn leaves them.

storyOdds.Name: Show the odds in the story
storyOdds.Hint: Ends the posted story with each side's simulated odds of winning.

standGround.Name: Fighter to the end stands firm (%)
standGround.Hint: Chance a character that fights to the end resists its own urge to run.

adhd.Name: ADHD: mind jumps
adhd.Hint: Chance a creature drops what it's doing for the strongest thing it wants.

leaveResolve.Name: Leaving creature keeps going
leaveResolve.Hint: Chance a creature leaving the fight keeps going when struck or spoken to.

roleplayForgets.Name: Roleplayer forgets opportunity attacks
roleplayForgets.Hint: Chance a character whose player ticked "Roleplaying is very important to me" forgets to play safe around opportunity attacks.

avoidKilling.Name: Killing-averse creature holds back (%)
avoidKilling.Hint: Chance a character that avoids killing holds back from a kill.

neutralReach.Name: Neutral friend groups: reach (squares)
neutralReach.Hint: How near a neutral must be to a friend group for the planner to put it in.

switchLuck.Name: Enemy changes sides
switchLuck.Hint: Chance an enemy talked into changing sides goes through with it; more for one scheming against its leaders. At 100, always.

executeLuck.Name: Downed PC finished off
executeLuck.Hint: Chance a creature that means to finish off a PC at 0 HP does.

leaderInfluence.Name: Leader's influence
leaderInfluence.Hint: How readily followers take their commander's lead. 0: nobody follows; 100: twice as readily as usual.

bossInfluence.Name: Boss's influence (×)
bossInfluence.Hint: How many times more readily followers take a boss's lead than a leader's.

focusDampener.Name: Dampen non-friendly focus fire
focusDampener.Hint: How much less creatures not on the Friendly side gang up on a foe their side has already hit. At 100, half as much.

traitorLuck.Name: PC turns traitor
traitorLuck.Hint: Chance a PC talked into changing sides goes through with it. At 0, never.

trapLuck.Name: Trap avoider spots a trap
trapLuck.Hint: Chance a trap avoider (a Thief most of all) spots each hazard.

tauntLuck.Name: Playstyle taunt takes hold
tauntLuck.Hint: Chance a playstyle's landed taunt takes hold; less for lesser taunters. A system's own taunts follow its rules.

partySway.Name: Friendly vote's sway (%)
partySway.Hint: How much the Friendly Team's vote sways the characters on the friendly side.

applyPlayerDamage.Name: Apply players' damage
applyPlayerDamage.Hint: A player's damage card against a creature FastFighting runs is applied at once. Off: the Battle Vantage asks a GM first.

playersRunPCs.Name: Players run their characters
playersRunPCs.Hint: Players take their characters' turns; FastFighting plays everyone else. Off: FastFighting plays every turn.

autoPlayAbsent.Name: Play for disconnected players
autoPlayAbsent.Hint: When all of a character's players have disconnected, FastFighting plays its turns after a countdown shown in the Battle Vantage. A player who returns takes over again after 12 seconds.

autoPlayAbsentSeconds.Name: Disconnected player countdown
autoPlayAbsentSeconds.Hint: How many seconds FastFighting waits before playing for a disconnected player.

ignoreTroubles.Name: Selfless creature shrugs off troubles
ignoreTroubles.Hint: Chance a selfless creature ignores what holds or hurts it and carries on; less the more selfish or calculating it is.

troubleshooting.Name: Troubleshooting
troubleshooting.Hint: Keeps each live battle's transcript for 30 days, even after its encounter is deleted, with the planner's last run. Turn it on before reporting a bug, then export from Live battle data. While on, a player who digs could read the last run's odds.

plannerWorkers.Name: Background workers
plannerWorkers.Hint: Runs the planner's fights on background threads, so the screen stays responsive and more fights fit the time. Workers that fail switch off and say so in the console.

Survey.Hint: Your setup, your battle and how many fights the planner ran: it helps make FastFighting faster.

waitHold.Name: Hold Next Turn for players
waitHold.Hint: While a player's turn waits for review, or their reaction is being rolled, the Battle Vantage's Next Turn stays locked this long.

loreBoost.Name: Lore-Collector advantage (×)
loreBoost.Hint: How many times likelier a Lore-Collector's rolls are to succeed after it sizes up a foe, against foes of that sort.

Loot.ItemPilesMissing: This system has no loot pile of its own. Install the Item Piles module, and goods dropped in a deal lie on the ground until picked up; without it, they change hands at once.
Loot.ItemPilesDisabled: This system has no loot pile of its own. Enable the Item Piles module, and goods dropped in a deal lie on the ground until picked up; without it, they change hands at once.
Loot.ItemPilesUnset: This system has no loot pile of its own, and Item Piles doesn't know this system yet. Set up Item Piles in its own settings (the actor a pile is), and goods dropped in a deal lie on the ground until picked up; until then, they change hands at once.

StatTip.ac: Makes it harder or easier to hit in this battle.
StatTip.hp: How much harm it can take in this battle.
StatTip.attack: Raises or lowers its attack rolls and save DCs in this battle.
StatTip.damage: Adds to or takes from each of its hits in this battle.
StatTip.leadBrave: Added to followers' bravery while their leader stands.
StatTip.leadTactical: Followers fight at least this cleverly while their leader stands.
StatTip.leadAttack: Added to followers' attack rolls while their leader stands.
StatTip.leadAc: Added to followers' {AC} while their leader stands.

TraitTip.tactical: How cleverly it picks targets, moves and uses its best options.
TraitTip.brave: How long it holds its ground before fleeing or giving up.
TraitTip.selfish: How much it puts itself before its friends.
TraitTip.loyal: How firmly it sticks with its side and its leader.
TraitTip.adhd: Increases the likelihood this creature would act on impulse.

Defaults.Hint: Each side's group personality. Members' own values blend with these; the planner can fudge both per battle.

Planner.Title: Battle Planner
Planner.SecondsHint: How long the prediction runs: fight after fight until the time is up.
Planner.FewFights: For the most accurate results, you want at least {least} fights.
Planner.PositioningHint: Distances, movement, terrain, walls and elevation.
Planner.RefreshHint: Re-read the tokens on the scene
Planner.ClearConfirm: Every planner choice for this encounter (sides, groups, roles, fudges and options) returns to the defaults. This can't be undone.
Planner.FightsRunHint: Fights simulated: in tens while running, then the exact count.
Planner.TraitBudgetHint: The four traits total {budget} at most. Raising one past that lowers the highest of the others. Playstyle and leader bonuses come on top.
Planner.RoleRemembered: Held this role in an earlier fight
Planner.RoleWantsToLead: The only one who wants to lead
Planner.Disposition: Tactics (ask your player, or use Prepare Players)
Planner.NoAdapter: FastFighting has no support for this game system yet. A helper module can add it.
Planner.HostileGroupHint: Hostile group: fights the Friendlies and the other groups.
Planner.NeutralGroupHint: Friend group: they look out for each other. Click to move.

TakesNoSide.friendly: Takes no side, leaning toward the Friendlies
TakesNoSide.hostile: Takes no side, leaning toward the enemy
TakesNoSide.closest: Takes no side, leaning toward the nearest side
TakesNoSide.underdog: Takes no side, leaning toward the underdog

Planner.TalkingHint: Characters may talk foes down: persuade, threaten or bluff.
Planner.IgnoreLanguagesHint: Anyone who speaks understands everyone who speaks.
Planner.BystandersHint: Tokens not in the encounter may notice it and join from the next round.
Planner.SceneChanged: You're viewing a different scene now. Run the battle again for this scene.
Planner.ThroughWall: no way round: through a wall
Planner.NoScene: No scene on the canvas. View the encounter's scene, then run the battle.
Planner.RoleHint: L: Leader, B: Boss ({boss}× as compelling), 1/2: Lieutenants (lead once the commander is gone)
Planner.PlayersRunHint: On: players take their own turns; FastFighting plays the rest. Off: FastFighting plays every turn.
Planner.ApplyDamageHint: A player's damage card against a creature FastFighting runs is applied at once. Off: the Battle Vantage asks a GM.
Planner.ReinforcementsHint: For each team, drop a creature from a compendium or the Actors directory and say how many can come. A team's leader calls them when the fight turns against it; they come the next round, from the map's far edge. The GM can call any team's in the Battle Vantage.
Planner.ReinforcementsActorOnly: Only a creature (an actor) can be a team's reinforcements.
Planner.LootHint: Put a chest or a bag on the map, then fill it in its own window. A thief, a greedy creature or a hungry one may want what's in it more than a fight.
Planner.PlaceLootClick: Click on the map where it goes (Escape to cancel).
Planner.PlaceLootFailed: Nothing could make a pile here: no Item Piles, and the system has no loot pile of its own.
Planner.PursesHint: What each team has besides what's on its sheets, in the system's coin, shared by the team for deals: bribes, tolls, extortion.
Planner.PartyPurseHint: The Friendly Team's own money, from its characters' sheets.
Planner.PausedHint: The planner paused the game when it opened. It goes on when the planner closes.
Planner.Fudged: Changed by the GM for this battle
Planner.Shared: These are the {side} side's settings, shared by {teams}.
Planner.SecretOnTeam: Also on this team, kept secret: {names}
Planner.SecretCard: Hidden from the players until revealed. Each fights for the team picked in its row.
Planner.FromCompendium: From a compendium? Drag it onto the slot instead.
Planner.SinceLastRun: Change since the last run, in points
Planner.RepickHint: Picks every leader, boss and lieutenant you didn't choose again, and fills empty roles. Teams and your own picks stay.
Planner.RepickAllHint: Picks every leader, boss and lieutenant again, yours too. Teams stay; the Friendly Team gets back the roles it held before.

preferredAction.Label: Favorite weapon or attack
preferredAction.Hint: Its go-to attack; it still switches when something else is clearly better.

style.Label: Fighting style
style.frontline: Front line: close in and hold the line
style.skirmisher: Skirmisher: flank, strike twice, keep moving
style.ranged: Ranged: keep my distance and shoot
style.protector: Protector: guard my allies, shield up

target.Label: Who to pursue first
target.Hint: Who it goes after first: to fight, or to talk round.

fallen.Label: Foes who fall
fallen.Hint: What it does with a downed foe. Spare them: avoids killing blows, first aid after. Tie them up: mostly takes them alive, as prisoners even if healed.

resourceUse.Label: Spell slots, focus and limited abilities
resourceUse.Hint: How readily it spends what only comes back after rest.
resourceUse.balanced: Use them when they are clearly better
resourceUse.nova: Spend freely to end it fast

specialty.Label: Magic and specialties
specialty.Hint: How often it picks spells and special abilities over weapons, moves or talk.

consumables.Label: Consumables
consumables.Hint: How readily it uses up potions, scrolls and bombs. Anyone will to save a life.
consumables.avoid: I don't like to use consumables
consumables.freely: Consumables are here to get used

healAggro.Label: Healing others
healAggro.Hint: How freely it spends actions and resources healing allies.
healAggro.conservative: Only when someone is dying or badly hurt
healAggro.allCosts: Heal at all costs, even with my last resources

allyDying.Label: When an ally is dying
allyDying.Hint: What it does when a friend goes down.

selfRevived.Label: After I'm revived
selfRevived.Hint: What it does after getting back up.

retreat.Label: When to retreat
retreat.losing: When the battle turns against us

shield.Label: Shield or defending
shield.Hint: How it uses Raise a Shield or a defensive turn (Dodge).
shield.spare: With spare actions, or when it's worth it

talk.Label: Talking instead of fighting
talk.Hint: Tries to end fights with words: persuade, threaten or bluff foes who share a language.
talk.always: Always talk unless I am currently being hurt
talk.first: Talk first: try to end it with words
talk.never: Let my weapons do the talking

beyond.Label: Others nearby
beyond.Hint: Creatures on the map not in the encounter: run to them for help, or hunt them after winning.
beyond.seekHelp: Run for help when it goes badly

Survey.NoPlayersHere: No players control tokens on this scene. Set tactics in each PC's row.

TokenTactics.Hint: FastFighting's playstyles and answers for this token.
TokenTactics.HazardHint: Traps and dangerous features: they don't move or talk, and can't be attacked.
TokenTactics.HungerHint: How hungry it comes to the fight. Hungry, it may break off to eat: food in a pile, or the meat of the fallen.
TokenTactics.SecretNameHint: A live battle's story calls it someone, however long the players have seen it. Off: it's named once a player's character has seen it, or from the start if its nameplate shows to everyone.

HazardMark.system: As the game system has it

TokenTactics.HazardNoTactics: A hazard has no tactics to set.
TokenTactics.HiddenHint: GM only: the hidden scores "Let this character decide" works from.

Playstyle.Label: Playstyles
Playstyle.Hint: Up to 4, most important first; later ones count less. They shape "Let this character decide".
Playstyle.Max: Pick at most four playstyles. Unpick one first.
Playstyle.StayTrue: Stay mostly true to my calculated tactical level
Playstyle.StayTrueHint: Stats, weapons and spells decide; the other settings here matter only a little.
Playstyle.Roleplay: Roleplaying is very important to me
Playstyle.RoleplayHint: Playstyles weigh double: their quirks show much more often.
Playstyle.Both: Both checked: roleplay strengthens your playstyles; staying true still caps them.

chicken.Name: Chicken
chicken.Hint: Much less brave: hangs back, drinks potions early, flees when hurt. Avoids the most dangerous foe.

cruel.Name: Cruel
cruel.Hint: Picks on the weakest, finishes the fallen, hits back hard.

moralist.Name: Moralist
moralist.Hint: Never strikes a fallen foe; heals friends, guards the weakest, calms quarrels.

peacekeeper.Name: Peacekeeper
peacekeeper.Hint: Calms quarrels, talks foes into standing down, never threatens, spares the fallen.

peoplePleaser.Name: People-Pleaser
peoplePleaser.Hint: Follows its leader closely, heals and guards friends, talks when it could work.

fragile.Name: Fragile
fragile.Hint: Drinks potions early and flees when hurt; once hurt, wants to get away and mend.

impatient.Name: Impatient
impatient.Hint: Charges the nearest foe, spends freely, skips the shield. Short fuse.

brawler.Name: Brawler
brawler.Hint: Loves melee: front line, nearest foe, hits back hard, no talking.

skeptic.Name: Skeptic
skeptic.Hint: Careful: saves resources, heals sparingly, hard to talk round or taunt, half swayed by its leader.

leader.Name: Wants to Lead
leader.Hint: Braver and loyal; goes for the biggest threat, rallies its people, half ignores its commander.

instigator.Name: Instigator
instigator.Hint: Acts first: locks foes down, goes for the most dangerous foe and its leader, taunts.

diplomat.Name: Diplomat
diplomat.Hint: Talks first and throughout, calms quarrels, often spares the fallen. Cool-headed when taunted.

wallflower.Name: Wallflower
wallflower.Hint: Stays at range and out of notice; would rather hamper than hit. Often ignores taunts.

kiter.Name: Kiter
kiter.Hint: Keeps its distance: strikes from out of reach and slips away again; picks on foes that can't follow.

martyr.Name: Martyr
martyr.Hint: Never retreats, heals at all costs, guards the weakest, avenges the fallen. Taunts foes off friends.

tank.Name: Tank
tank.Hint: Takes the blows: taunts foes off friends, guards the weakest, never retreats, shield up.

mercenary.Name: Mercenary
mercenary.Hint: In it for itself: easy targets, saves resources, little loyalty, gives up when it gets hard.

enabler.Name: Enabler
enabler.Hint: Makes friends better: bolsters them first, then gives them an edge over foes; heals only when it has nothing else to give.

medic.Name: Medic
medic.Hint: Heals first and early, the dying above all; keeps its healing for healing, bolsters when nobody's hurt, stays close.

dps.Name: DPS
dps.Hint: Damage above all: its most damaging option every time, spent until it's gone; picks the foes it hurts most.

redeemSeeker.Name: Redeem-Seeker
redeemSeeker.Hint: Out to prove itself: takes on the biggest threat from the front line, never gives up.

loreCollector.Name: Lore-Collector
loreCollector.Hint: Sizes up new foes first, then rolls much better against their kind; may share what it learns.

puzzleManiac.Name: Puzzle-Maniac
puzzleManiac.Hint: Very tactical: exploits weaknesses, targets casters, loves lock-downs and locked doors.

wildcard.Name: Wildcard
wildcard.Hint: Unpredictable: random targets, ignores advice, may defy its leader.

thief.Name: Thief
thief.Hint: Light fingers: may rob a foe within reach when winning or unseen. A lock is an invitation.

Playstyle.AvoidCostlySpells: I don't like to use spells that cost something
Playstyle.AvoidCostlySpellsHint: Spells that use slots, focus or daily uses only when a life is at stake. Cantrips are free.

vengeful.Name: Vengeful
vengeful.Hint: Never forgets: hits back twice as hard, avenges fallen friends.

relentless.Name: Relentless
relentless.Hint: Single-minded: sticks with its foe, shrugs off setbacks, hard to taunt away.

lazy.Name: Lazy
lazy.Hint: Does as little as it can: nearest foe, saves resources, gives up fast.

unmundane.Name: Un-Mundane
unmundane.Hint: Leans on its magic and special abilities over plain weapons or talk; spends freely.

Playstyle.EffectsHint: GM only: what these playstyles do to the hidden scores and habits.

Desire.Label: Desires

Live.SystemApplies: {name} applies players' damage itself, so this does nothing while that's on.
Live.DamageWaits: {name}'s damage waits in the Battle Vantage for a GM to apply.
Live.HealingWaits: {name}'s healing waits in the Battle Vantage for a GM to apply.
Live.DamageChanged: {name}'s damage card changed after it was put before you ({was}, now {now}), so nothing was applied. Look at it again in the Battle Vantage.
Live.Disrupted: {by}'s critical hit disrupts what {name} was doing.
Live.YourReaction: {name}: roll your {reaction} at {target} now, as you would on your turn, then press the button.
Live.NoCombat: There is no combat on this scene to play the battle on.
Live.Failed: The live battle hit a problem: {error}

FastStopped.tracker: Fast Fight stopped: the tracker was moved.
FastStopped.player: Fast Fight stopped: a player's character is theirs to play.
FastStopped.gm: Fast Fight stopped: a GM's answer is needed.
FastStopped.still: Fast Fight stopped: a whole round went by with nothing changing. Press it again to go on.

Live.AwayPlayed: {names}: no player came back in time, so FastFighting plays their turns now.
Live.SheetUnread: Couldn't read {name}'s sheet; FastFighting keeps what it last knew. The console says why.
Live.TrackerRefused: {name} moved the live battle's turn order; FastFighting put it back. Only a GM may, though players can end their own turns.
Live.SpotlightRefused: {name} gave the spotlight to a character that isn't theirs; FastFighting put it back. Players can only take it for their own characters.
Live.TooFarBack: FastFighting doesn't keep turns that far back, so it put the tracker back where it was. Rewind This Encounter can still undo the whole battle.
Live.AftermathHint: The dying bleed out or hold on, the beaten are dealt with, and goods go back to their owners.
Live.RewindAllConfirm: Undo the whole battle: every turn, card and move?
Live.PickedUp: FastFighting picked up the live battle where it was.
Live.NotHere: That battle isn't being played in this browser.

Deal.TalkOk: {actor} wants to make a deal with {target}. Can they understand each other?
Deal.NoAnswer: No answer in time: {name}'s nature decides.
Deal.Denied: The GM said no: no deal.
Deal.ReviewCard: A deal waits for your review: {what}
Deal.WordlessYes: yes: a threat it can only show
Deal.RefuseChance: Says no though it got through
Deal.ReviewHint: Approve lets the deal stand as it is; Deny means there's no deal.

Deal.OpenDeal: I want to bribe or extort
Deal.DemandHint: Demand nothing, and you just tell them to go.
Deal.NoGm: No GM is here to settle a deal.

Kind.extort: Make them pay, or just tell them to go
Kind.toll: Ask a toll: pay me and I'll go

Why.language: They don't understand a word you say.
Why.unheard: The GM says they can't make themselves understood.
Why.none: That deal can't be made now.
Why.noToll: Only one who acted before all their foes, or surprised them, can ask a toll.
Why.unseen: You don't perceive them from where you stand.
Why.tooFar: They're too far away to talk to.

Why.player: Not trusted: a player can see it.
Why.editor: Not trusted: last changed by someone who isn't a GM.
Why.inPlay: still in play on its encounter

LiveData.CleanUp: Clean up older than a month
LiveData.WillRemove: Delete these {n} journals, last kept more than {days} days ago?
LiveData.NothingOld: Nothing was last kept more than {days} days ago.
LiveData.NothingOldHeld: Nothing to delete: the {n} journals older than {days} days are still in play.

Battle.None: No live battle is being played in this browser.

State.waiting: Played: check it, then Next Turn

Battle.AutomateHint: FastFighting plays the rest of this character's turns. Clear it to hand them back to their player.
Battle.AwayTimer: None of this character's players is connected. When this runs out, FastFighting plays their turns.
Battle.SpotlightHint: Give the spotlight to whoever FastFighting would pick next.
Battle.ApplyDamageHint: A player's damage card against a creature FastFighting runs is applied at once. Off: it waits here for a GM.

GmRoll.Title: A roll for the GM

GmRoll.Check: {who}'s check for {what}, DC {dc}: how did it go?

Battle.PlayThroughHint: FastFighting's turns run back to back, without waiting for Next Turn.

Battle.FastFightStopHint: Stops the Fast Fight once the turn under way is done. Then it waits for Next Turn as usual.
Battle.NpcAskHint: On: FastFighting asks before an NPC uses a reaction. Off: its tactics decide.
Battle.Held: Told with this player's turn when it ends:
Battle.PickWho: Pick who it was about first.
Battle.ReviewTitle: {name}'s turn: what was read. Keep, drop or set right, then tell it.

Net.Label: Map of minds
Net.Reset: Lay them out as on the map again

Net.NotInBattle: On the map, not in this battle
Net.AddHint: What {name} wants of someone, has on them (and from whom), or what came of a roll at the table.
